name: Resize Image Online
label: Change Dimensions & Scale in Seconds
description: Resize JPG, PNG, and WebP images online for free. Adjust image dimensions to exact pixels or scale proportionally while preserving crisp visual quality.
how: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image from your device.
Enter your target width and height in pixels, or keep proportions to fit cleanly inside dimensions.
Click to resize and download your optimized image instantly.
faq: Keeping proportions active scales your photo proportionally to fit inside your target width and height without distortion. Disabling it stretches or squashes the image to match exact pixel numbers.

name: Best Image Compressor
label: Reduce Image Size in KB at Optimal Quality
description: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images online for free. Reduce image file size to custom KB targets or scale dimensions without losing visual quality.
how: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP file to compress.
Set your desired quality percentage, dimension scale, or specify an optional target file size in KB.
Compare the compressed file size and download your optimized image immediately.
faq: Can all images reach very small targets like 20 KB? If an image has high pixel dimensions, lowering quality alone reaches a compression floor. Use the Size percentage slider to downscale dimensions proportionally and hit small KB limits while keeping details sharp.

name: Image Converter Online
label: Convert JPG, PNG & WebP in Seconds
description: Free online image converter to quickly transform photos between JPG, PNG, and WebP formats directly in your browser with instant preview.
how: Select any supported JPG, PNG, or WebP picture.
Choose your desired output format (JPG for maximum compatibility, PNG or WebP for transparency).
Convert and download your new image file instantly.
faq: PNG and WebP formats fully support background transparency. Converting a transparent PNG to JPG will automatically replace transparent areas with a clean white background.

name: Merge PDF Online
label: Combine Multiple PDF Files Into One
description: Merge PDF files online for free in your browser. Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file in any custom order with 100% privacy.
how: Select two or more PDF files from your computer or phone.
Use the up and down arrows to arrange documents in the exact order you want them merged.
Click merge and download your unified PDF document.
faq: Does merging keep document quality? Yes, all original page vectors, text, and graphics remain intact. Note that password-protected or heavily encrypted PDFs must be unlocked before merging.

name: Organize & Reorder PDF Pages
label: Extract, Delete, Rearrange & Sort Pages
description: Organize and rearrange PDF pages online for free. Extract specific pages, change page sequences, or duplicate sheets with complete client-side security.
how: Choose a PDF file to view its total page count.
Enter your desired sequence (for example: 3, 1-2, 5) to reorder, extract, or duplicate pages.
Generate and download your freshly organized PDF.
faq: How do page ranges work? Entering '1-5' includes pages one through five in standard order, while entering '5-1' reverses their sequence. Unlisted pages are excluded from the output.

name: Images to PDF Converter
label: Convert Photos & Pictures to PDF Document
description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP photos into a single PDF document online. Combine multiple pictures into neat A4, US Letter, or original aspect ratio pages.
how: Select your photos or documents and order them as needed.
Pick your preferred layout: standard A4 portrait, US Letter, or fit page to original image size.
Create and download your formatted PDF document.
faq: Will my images be cropped? No, images fit proportionally inside your chosen page boundaries without cropping. Standard A4 and Letter choices center images with clean margins.
